IS 9263 ( Part 2 ) : 1999 5 DESIGNATION 5.1 The jewels shall be designated by the type of jewel, the major dimensions, such as &, d2, hl, etc, and the number of this standard. Platjewels/ring jewels/convex jewels with straight/olived hole having hole diameter dl - 0.16 mm, jewel diameter h - 0.9 mm and thickness hl - 0.22 mm shall be designated as: FSH 0.16 x 0.9 x 0.22 IS 9263 (Part 2) FOH 0.16 x 0.9 x 0.22 IS 9263 (Part 2) ROH 0.16 x 0.9 x 0.22 IS 9263 (Part 2) CSH 0.16 x 0.9 x 0.22 IS 9263 (Part 2) COH 0.16 x 0.9 x 0.22 IS 9263 (Part 2) b) Cap jewels, flat/convex types having diameter d2 = 1.2 mm and thickness ht = 0.25 mm shall be designated as: CF 1.2 x 0.25 IS 9263 (Part 2) CC 1.2 x 0.25 IS 9263 (Part 2) V-jewel having diameter dl = 1.2 mm, thickness hl=l .5 mm and radius at V-recess r = 0.125 mm shall be designated as: V 1.2 x I .5 x 0.125 IS 9263 (Part 2)

a>

c>

6 MATERIAL 6.1 Horological jewels are made out of natural or synthetic material. Commonly used jewel materials colourless corrundum and synthetic ruby or sapphire. The general properties of the materials are: Density : 3.98 Hardness : Mohs : 9 Knoop : 1 800 - 2 200 kgf/mm* Vickers : 2 500 - 3 000 kgf/mm* Modulus of elasticity : 36000-44000MPa Tensile strength : 260MPa Compressive strength : 2 160 MPa Melting point : 2050�c Index of refraction : 1.768//C (sodium D-line) : 1.760 C Chemical resistance : Practically inert to all chemical agents, even at high temperatures 7 QUALITY 7.1 Jewels shall be free from visual defects, such as oval hole, broken or chipped off edges at the hole as well as at outside edges, scratches and poor surface finish at the hole and on flat/convex surfaces, cracks, air cavities, discontinuous livecut leaving sharp edge in the hole, etc, when examined using a stereoscopic microscope with a minimum magnification of 16 times under suitable light (Neon light) condition. 7.2 The lateral surface shall have ground finish and the remaining surfaces. jewel surfaces shall have highly polished The radii shall be 10 pm at (4) and are

7.3 The edges of the hole (4), at recess (5) and outside (6) shall be rounded. 20 urn at (5) and (6). 7.4 The bevel (7) shall be properly shaped (bevel angle 100 pm). 7.5 The jewels shall be properly cleaned. 7.6 The concentricity 8 TREATMENT Jewels after manufacture, 9 MARKING

25' and radius to merge with the lateral surface -

of the hole of the jewel with respect to the outer diameter shall be within 3 pm.

shall be treated suitably to obtain a high degree of oil retention property.

The label containing each pack shall be marked with the source of manufacture jewels; quantity of jewels; and batch number/year of manufacture. 10 PACKAGING

or trade-mark,

if any, type of

Jewels shall be wrapped in tissue paper and then packed in a manner which will ensure proper protection identification. Different types and sizes of jewels shall not be packed in the same packing. 14

Standards are also reviewed periodically; a standard along with amendments is reaffirmed when such review indicates that no changes are needed; if the review indicates that changes are needed, it is taken up for revision.
